title: baloghia inophylla
intro: Baloghia inophylla, commonly known as the "Sapaul or Putoy", is a plant species that belongs to the Rubiaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its health benefits, such as the ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Baloghia inophylla include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which can help to alleviate various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
